claim_text: FIFA says a criminal cyberattack gave unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information
summary: FIFA says: "FIFA can confirm that it has been the victim of a criminal cyberattack resulting in unauthorised access to a limited set of personal and business information." It sent the statement to news outlets on Nov 25 and 26.
detail: FIFA has published no notice on its own website that we could find; the statement reached the public through news organisations, each of which says FIFA sent it to them.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Record, Al Jazeera and The Associated Press each report receiving FIFA's statement themselves.

claim_text: FIFA says it is working with the authorities and law enforcement
summary: FIFA says: "FIFA is working closely with the relevant authorities, including law enforcement." It does not name the authorities.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Record and The Associated Press quote the same line from statements FIFA sent each of them.

claim_text: A group calling itself the Handsome Boy Hacking Club claims it stole more than 12 GB of FIFA data
summary: The Record reports the Handsome Boy Hacking Club claimed it stole more than 12 GB, tried to extort FIFA and then published the data on a criminal forum. AP says the group posted a screenshot of claimed FIFA files last week.
detail: This is the group's own claim. FIFA has not named who attacked it or confirmed the 12 GB figure. The Record says the group emerged last week and little is known about it. We did not open the forum or any leaked material.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Both outlets describe the group's claim; neither says FIFA confirmed it.

claim_text: The attackers reportedly got in by impersonating FIFA staff, not through a technical failure
summary: Al Jazeera reports that a FIFA source told The Athletic that whoever carried out the attack gained access by impersonating staff, rather than through a systems or technical failure.
detail: FIFA itself has not said publicly how the attackers got in.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Al Jazeera relays The Athletic's anonymous FIFA source; FIFA has said nothing on it publicly.

claim_text: FIFA has not said how many people were affected, when the attack happened or what the information was
summary: FIFA did not say how many people or organisations were affected, when the attack took place or what the business information included, The Associated Press and Al Jazeera report.
detail: FIFA's statement speaks of "the individuals concerned" without saying who they are. Nothing FIFA has said mentions fans or ticket holders.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: Both outlets say FIFA gave none of these details.

claim_text: FIFA condemns the publication of the information
summary: FIFA says it "condemns in the strongest possible terms the unlawful acquisition and publication of information, particularly personal data", calling it "a serious and unacceptable violation of privacy".
detail: Al Jazeera notes that FIFA did not say whether any data had appeared online, or where.
label: Confirmed
why_it_supports: The Record and The Associated Press quote the same words from FIFA's statement.

claim_text: A person familiar with the matter says less than 0.1 percent of FIFA's data was affected
summary: Al Jazeera reports that a person with knowledge of the matter told Reuters less than 0.1 percent of FIFA's data was affected; media reports say no files from FIFA's abandoned Forward Enterprise project were accessed.
detail: An anonymous source; FIFA has not given a figure.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: Al Jazeera relays Reuters' anonymous source.

claim_text: The group claims the data includes identity and immigration documents, financial, legal and governance records
summary: The Record reports that the stolen data allegedly includes identity and immigration documents, financial records, legal documents and governance information.
detail: This is what the group says it took. FIFA has not described the data beyond 'personal and business information'.
label: Reported
why_it_supports: The Record reports the group's description and marks it as alleged.
